_why: Per-city facts for the city x service pages under areas/ (scripts/generators/build_area_pages.js). One entry per city in data/service_areas/areas.json, same order; validate:area-pages fails if the two lists differ. Only public-record geography (county, state, which side of Memphis) and facts this repo already holds (travel included per services.json travel; rentals pickup at Mt. Moriah Station per games.json pickup; the area and local pages already published). No neighborhoods, venues, reviews, counts or claims that are not on record here. Added 21 Oct 2026 (owner-approved build: a page for each suburb for every service).
